SCI p.4 prints the three-month and nine-month columns side by side; the tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', prints amounts with the profit-or-loss sign (1Q and 2Q2025: a credit printed positive), so it is kept as printed. Note 8 nine months (p.45 revenue and incurred claims, p.46 other expenses and reinsurance, p.47 reinsurance total; columns ordinary / industrial / credit group / group / total; no PAA business) prints expenses positive (turned negative; the bracketed past-service figure becomes positive). CSM roll-forward 9.1.2 (ณ วันที่ 30 กันยายน 2568) p.55, closing p.56; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment relating to future service (CSM column). New business 9.1.3 p.58: unlike 1Q2025 the 2568 inflows are printed without brackets (kept positive, as in 2Q2025). The nine months turn to a profit after a third-quarter profit; the tax line, labelled 'expense (income)', now prints an expense in brackets (profit before tax - expense = net profit), kept as printed. The opening CSM (250,261,717.61, as in 1Q2025) differs from the 1 January 2568 CSM in the FY2025 annual statements (246,228,997.42). The three-month profit or loss is the SCI three-month column (p.4).
